scope: Observe the AC1032 IMAGEDEF owner encoded with offset soft-pointer code 0xC, retain the resolved target and exact source capture, and preserve strict output refusal while the field's semantic role conflicts with ODA's IMAGEDEF hard-owner declaration.

source.provenance: Tracked ACadSharp sample, read-only; no source or derivative was added to this repository.

format_authority.name: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

sections.2.13: Code 0xC is an offset handle that subtracts the encoded offset from the reference handle; offset handle codes always represent soft pointers.
sections.20.4.81: AcDbRasterImageDef's parenthandle is specified as a hard owner.

format_authority.limit: The specification states its version coverage ends at R2013. Section 2.13 supplies the general offset-code rule used to interpret this AC1032 observation; it does not qualify AC1032 IMAGEDEF output semantics.

implementation.behavior: The independent raster wire observer decodes code 0xC using the existing bounded soft-pointer offset arithmetic only for a custom AC1032 IMAGEDEF profile. It records the resolved parent and returns UnqualifiedOwnerRole. The adapter retains the source and explicitly refuses output with the owner-role diagnostic; code 0xC is not reclassified as hard ownership and does not promote output support. Debug traces identify the failing raster capture/correlation stage and handle.
